# Read-only review handoff

- Initiating host / conversation / owner:
- Receiving host / execution session (observed, never invented):
- Model (observed, or unknown):
- Dispatch ID / portable role / contract hash:
- Isolation / allowed tools / forbidden tools:
- Baseline / HEAD / index tree / selected paths:
- Goal and acceptance gates:
- Actual commands / exits / limitations:
- Changes since previous review / repeated root cause:
- Timeout / unavailable behavior:

Review only this subject. Do not edit, execute commands, authorize, commit,
push, publish, adopt alignment or inherit proofs. Report blockers first with
file/line, trigger, expected/actual behavior and evidence. Distinguish observed
failures, hypotheses and environment limits. If no supported issue exists,
explicitly state No issues found. Return observed execution identity and tools
used; missing information stays unknown.
